seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [counter,player,reflection,target] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Frame-native 21x21 block model: H axis (row, A1/A2) and V axis (col, A3/A4), selection shown by 0 centres; A5 cycles H->V->pieces by min block.
Wall A1 mixed outcome = selection: A1 moves H only when H is selected, otherwise it moves the selected piece or is a no-op.
Pieces blocked by board edge/other pieces; axes bounded by the board only and pass under pieces.
Every piece block mirrors as gray 4 across V, across H and across both (skip off-board/piece-occupied); centre priority target 11 > selected wall 0 > selected piece 0 > refl 4 > bg 9.
HUD col 63 turns next 11->12 only on effective actions; stateless (44/44). Unconfirmed: piece entering an axis row, touching-piece split while an axis is selected.
